title: APO-DD: Dialogue Disentanglement via Reflective Optimization of Multi-Component Prompts
abstract: arXiv:2606.07894v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In multi-party chat, interleaved dialogues make it difficult to identify the context of each utterance. Dialogue disentanglement separates these dialogues to support dialogue analysis and response generation. Prompt refinement can improve large language models' (LLMs') accuracy on this task, but manually finding effective prompts for each LLM requires extensive trial and error. We propose APO-DD, which adapts GEPA to optimize prompts using execution traces and reflections on failed decisions. It updates task instructions directly and chat representations through automatically generated formatting functions. We compare optimizing either component alone or both. With Qwen3.5-9B, the best optimized prompt achieves an average score of 68.7 across seven evaluation metrics on Ubuntu IRC, compared with 57.5 for the best manually refined prompt. It also outperforms manually refined prompts on other chat domains without further optimization.

translated_title: APO-DD：通过多组件提示词的反思性优化实现对话解缠
translated_abstract: 在多方聊天中，相互交织的对话使得识别每条话语的上下文变得困难。对话解缠将这些对话分离开来，以支持对话分析和回复生成。提示词优化可以提高大型语言模型（LLM）在此任务上的准确性，但为每个LLM手动寻找有效提示词需要大量的反复试验。我们提出了APO-DD，它改编了GEPA方法，利用执行轨迹和对错误决策的反思来优化提示词。该方法直接更新任务指令，并通过自动生成的格式化函数更新聊天表示。我们比较了单独优化任一组件或同时优化两者的情况。使用Qwen3.5-9B模型，优化后的最佳提示词在Ubuntu IRC数据集的七个评估指标上平均得分为68.7，而最佳手动优化提示词的得分仅为57.5。在其他聊天领域中，它无需进一步优化即可超越手动优化的提示词。
tldr: APO-DD通过改编GEPA框架，利用执行轨迹和错误决策反思自动优化任务指令与聊天表示两个组件，其优化后的提示词在对话解缠任务上显著超越手动优化的提示词，且在其他聊天领域无需进一步优化即可保持优势。
en_tdlr: APO-DD adapts GEPA to automatically optimize both task instructions and chat representations using execution traces and reflections on failed decisions, with its optimized prompts significantly outperforming manually refined ones on dialogue disentanglement across multiple chat domains without further tuning.
